Read more Book now SEE MORE SEE MORE FAQs SEE MORE Where is Fortuna Hotel Hanoi located? Fortuna Hotel Hanoi is situated at 6B Lang Ha Street, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam. What are the room amenities available at the Fortuna Hotel Hanoi? Our newly refurbished rooms offer a tranquil sanctuary, harmonizing modern aesthetics with allergen-free environments. High-speed WiFi, flat-screen TVs, and optional luxurious jacuzzis are just a few of the amenities that await you. Premium rooms also offer exclusive Capital Lounge access. How far and how long is the journey from the hotel to Noi Bai International Airport? Our hotel is approximately 30 km from the airport. The travel time typically takes between 45 minutes and an hour, depending on the traffic. Is the hotel near any popular tourist attractions? Yes, we’re located close to several key attractions. The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the One Pillar Pagoda, the Temple of Literature, and the historic Old Quarter are all within a 10-20 minute drive. Does the hotel offer concierge services to provide insider knowledge of the places of interest? Yes, our expert concierge team is always on hand to help guests explore the city, from recommending restaurants and providing directions to landmarks, to booking city tours.
